messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-04-05 02:00-03:00 UTC. Components: runtime v2.4.0, api v3.1.0, router v1.7.2, console v0.9.5. Canary plan: router -> 5% to new stack, healthchecks enabled. Pin request: api=3.1.0, runtime=2.4.0.

sara: tagging this thread for cross-svc interlock. main ask: exact rollout order and any manual hold points. :eyes:

liam: runtime has a micro-benchmark regression fix in 2.4.0 that requires a kernel selector bump. we need to pin runtime image SHA (not just tag) for Dedicated. prefer deploy order: runtime -> api -> router -> console toggle.

anya: API 3.1.0 introduces the /v2/session field. console needs a migration flag. we can feature-flag it but console toggle must be manual after router updates. also request: add schema-compat check in canary.

olivia: agreed on manual console toggle. I'll hold the UI flag behind admin toggle. Please provide the exact API spec change we should validate.

marco: router plan: update rules to route 5% to api:3.1.0 with header-based affinity off. healthcheck endpoints: /health/runtime, /health/api. If api responds 200 but runtime returns 503, we should auto-fallback. Need to confirm health timeout settings (current 3s).

liam: recommend increasing runtime healthcheck window in deploy to 10s during canary warm-up to avoid false positives. also note: runtime v2.4.0 requires node-side config /etc/runtime/kv_cache tuned. will add k8s kustomize patch.

anya: adding quick schema check script. run in canary pods: 
```bash
curl -sS http://canary-api.internal/v2/schema | jq .fields | grep session || exit 1
```
If that fails, abort traffic shift.

release-checker-bot: Preflight summary: unit tests ✅, integration smoke ✅, e2e flaky tests: 2/12 flaked (investigate but not blocking). Security scan: no high issues. Pin recommendation: api=3.1.0-rc1 -> require final approval.

sara: decision checklist: (1) runtime SHA pinned? (2) api pin to rc1 ok? (3) router health timeout to 10s for canary? (4) console manual toggle? If yes to all, we stagger with a 15min observation after runtime and api shift.

liam: runtime SHA pinned: sha256:3b2f9c... (confirmed). will push k8s patch under deploy runbook.

anya: api pin to 3.1.0-rc1 is fine, but we'll hold final GA tag until post-canary. rc1 includes the schema change.

marco: I'll change router health timeout to 10s in the canary rule and add auto-fallback on runtime 5xx.

olivia: console toggle set to manual. I'll be on standby during the 15min observation window.

sara: plan approved. rollout order and timing: 02:00 runtime (canary nodes), wait 15m observe -> 02:20 api canary + router 5% -> wait 15m observe -> 02:50 gradual router ramp / console toggle at 02:55 if green. Manual abort contact list: @liam @anya @marco @olivia.

deploy-bot: Execution scheduled. To start deploy runbook, run: 
```bash
./scripts/deploy.sh --components runtime,api,router,console --order runtime,api,router,console --pins runtime=sha256:3b2f9c...,api=3.1.0-rc1 --window 02:00-03:00UTC
```
Deploy runbook link: https://confluence.internal/r/rb/infra-cross-svc-deploy-2026-04-05

release-checker-bot: Locking change window and recording pins. Will post a canary health summary at +15m and +30m.

sara: thanks everyone. if any objection before 01:30 UTC ping here. otherwise proceeding. :thumbsup:
